title: ClimaCuddle® Baby Bodysuit Long Sleeve - Merino Wool & Rayon From Bamboo - Dusty Pink - 3-6M
description: Thoughtfully crafted from Merino wool and bamboo rayon, this newborn and infant long sleeve bodysuit delivers breathable softness and natural temperature regulation—ideal for sensitive skin. Whether layered as an undershirt or worn solo, it's the go-to baby bodysuit for all-season comfort. ClimaCuddle climate-smart fabric : 50.8% rayon from bamboo | 49.2% Merino wool Adjustable SnoozySeal closures for quick diaper changes and growing bellies Fold-over cuffs for warmth and scratch protection Flatlock stitching for a seamless, scratch-free feel Breathable underarm gusset Envelope Shoulders for easy dressing Temperature-sensing sticker signals to adjust layers Personalized embroidery adds a unique touch to special moments.
